== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Located at the center of the [[Imperial]] Palace, the Emperor's personal rooms consist of a suite of chambers characterized by immense wealth and historical significance. The quarters feature polished wood walls, antique paintings that are centuries old, and a massive bed capable of holding ten people. The space also contains an [[armory]] for the Emperor's weapons and a functional bathroom with plumbing. Historically, the rooms were designed so that the Emperor lacked privacy, as palace servants would dress him within these walls. The most critical component of the suite is the [[Optasia]], the Emperor's true [[throne]]. This device is built into a hidden nook within the walls and serves as a central command hub. By using the [[Optasia]] alongside a global network of receptors, the Emperor can monitor and influence the [[Great Elders]] from a distance. The physical state of the chambers has been subject to extreme transformation and [[destruction]]. The rooms have been overtaken by organic, fleshy growths resembling a living beast, with walls covered in gristle, tendons, and skin. Following various conflicts, the suite has suffered significant structural damage, including shattered [[furniture]], cracked walls, and peeled floorboards. Despite this chaos, the area remains a site of immense power, containing high concentrations of [[Intent]].}}
